output.summary: The 98.1% figure reflects a metric change, not better service. Revisions per 100 shipments jumped from about 2.9 to 14.1. The reason-code mix shifted to Operational-Capacity, late same-day revisions rose, and customer notification fell. The jumps began when the bonus took effect, in March at Northgate and Riverside and in July at Pell Junction. RouteWise timing doesn't fit: Northgate jumped before it had RouteWise, and Pell Junction had it but didn't jump until July. Brightwell's dock logs show 81% on time against the original date, down from 87%, while the scorecard claimed 98.4%. Lateness complaints rose while damage and billing complaints were flat. Suspend the claim, audit the revisions and re-base the incentive. The driver-shortage link is unestablished.
